## 设备对比分析
**对比设备**: OPA188, OPA211

### 参数对比
| 参数 | OPA188 | OPA211 |
|---|---|---|
| **供电电压** | - | - |
| **输出高电平** | - | - |
| **输出低电平** | 0.2 V | 0.2 V |
| **输入高电平** | - | - |
| **输入低电平** | - | - |
| **输出高电流** | - | - |
| **输出低电流** | - | - |
| **传播延迟** | - | - |

### 分析结果
基于三层架构评分体系（CCM + Z-A-FoM + B-SPOTIS），推荐选择 **OPA188**，综合得分 21.4 分，数据可靠度 中等。主要优势：output_voltage_low表现优秀, temperature_range表现优秀, package_size控制良好。备选方案：OPA211（21.4分）。

**评分排名**:
- OPA188: 21.41
- OPA211: 21.41

This miniature, highprecision, low-quiescent current amplifier offers high input impedance and rail-to-rail output swing within 15 mV of the rails. The input common-mode range includes the negative rail. Either single or dual supplies can be used in the range from 4 V to 36 V (±2 V to ±18 V). The single version is available in the MicroSIZE SOT-23-5, MSOP-8, and SO-8 packages. All versions are specified for operation from –40°C to +125°C.

This ac performance, combined with only 125 μV of offset and 0.35 $\mu \mathrm { V } / \dot { \mathrm { ^ { o } C } }$ of drift over temperature, makes the OPAx211 series a great choice for driving high-precision 16-bit analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) or buffering the output of high-resolution digital-to-analog converters (DACs). The OPAx211 series is specified over a wide dualpower supply range of ±2.25 to ±18 V, or for singlesupply operation from 4.5 to 36 V.
